CONTEXT. The pipeline's LLM stages shell the Claude Code CLI as a subprocess under OAuth/subscription billing (server/pipeline/api_base.py run_claude_json; claude_cli_env strips ANTHROPIC_API_KEY so the CLI can never bill through an API key). The owner's directive (2026-07-28): wire BACKUP MODELS — when a Claude CLI call fails, automatically retry ONCE on the Codex CLI under Codex OAuth, mapping the intended Claude tier to a Codex model: opus (and sonnet) -> "gpt-5.6-sol" at reasoning effort xhigh; haiku -> "gpt-5.6-luna" at reasoning effort xhigh. Subscription-only is a HARD rule: per-token API billing is forbidden on both lanes.

THE CHANGE:
1. server/config.py: add PODCAST_CODEX_FALLBACK_ENABLED (env "PODCAST_CODEX_FALLBACK", default true) and a fallback map constant CODEX_FALLBACK_MODELS = {"opus": "gpt-5.6-sol", "sonnet": "gpt-5.6-sol", "haiku": "gpt-5.6-luna"} with a single effort constant CODEX_FALLBACK_REASONING_EFFORT = "xhigh"; each mapping overridable via env (PODCAST_CODEX_FALLBACK_OPUS, PODCAST_CODEX_FALLBACK_HAIKU, PODCAST_CODEX_FALLBACK_EFFORT). Follow the existing config style (comments explaining WHY, env-overridable, no code change to retune).
2. server/pipeline/api_base.py:
   a. Add codex_cli_env(): like claude_cli_env but ALSO strips OPENAI_API_KEY (and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) so the Codex CLI always uses its OAuth login, never API-key billing.
   b. Add run_codex_json(full_prompt, model_alias, timeout): shells ["codex","exec","-s","read-only","-m",<mapped model>,"-c","model_reasoning_effort=<effort>", full_prompt], capture stdout, reuse the SAME fence-stripping + JSON-extraction logic run_claude_json uses (factor that parsing into a shared helper rather than duplicating it). Unknown alias: log and map to the opus entry (safest tier). Returns parsed JSON or None; respects placeholder_mode() by returning None.
   c. Extend run_claude_json signature to run_claude_json(full_prompt, timeout=120, model=None) — backward compatible, existing 4 call sites pass no model and keep working; when model is given, pass ["--model", model] to the claude command. On PRIMARY FAILURE ONLY — FileNotFoundError, TimeoutExpired, returncode != 0, or empty stdout — and when PODCAST_CODEX_FALLBACK_ENABLED, log the failure and return run_codex_json(full_prompt, model or "opus", timeout). A successful claude call whose output merely fails JSON parsing is NOT a fallback trigger (same prompt would likely fail anywhere; do not double-spend).
   d. Never fall back when placeholder_mode() is on (no spend in tests), and never retry the fallback itself (one claude attempt, at most one codex attempt, then None).
3. Keep the docstrings honest: note the fallback exists, the model map lives in config, and both lanes are OAuth-only by construction (stripped env).

TESTS (tests/test_model_fallback.py, mock subprocess.run — no real CLI, no network; at least 5 tests):
(1) claude rc!=0 -> codex invoked with -m gpt-5.6-sol and model_reasoning_effort=xhigh when model is None/opus; (2) haiku maps to gpt-5.6-luna; (3) NEGATIVE: claude success -> codex NEVER invoked (assert single subprocess call); (4) NEGATIVE: fallback disabled via env -> codex never invoked even on failure; (5) codex env has OPENAI_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY stripped while claude env strips ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (seed both keys into os.environ via monkeypatch and inspect the env= kwarg of each call); (6) placeholder_mode -> returns None with zero subprocess calls. Also cover TimeoutExpired triggering fallback if cheap to add.
